note: Re-judged 2026-10-11 by an independent judge after the fix round (2691e815b1) added the disposition pair. RFC 4301 4.4.1, under "The SPD MUST permit a user or administrator to specify policy entries as follows:": "SPD-O: For outbound traffic that is to be bypassed or discarded, the entry consists of the values of the selectors that apply to the traffic to be bypassed or discarded." The engine units judged before (TestSPDPolicyMirrorsTheInboundSelector, TestRFC4301InboundBypassReturnTrafficHasAnSPDOEntry, TestRFC4301BypassSPDOEntryIsNeverAnUnmirroredCopy) are unchanged and carry the selector half (records on spdPolicyParams). The added positive TestRFC4301SPDPermitsEachDispositionInEachDatabase shows bypass and discard with direction out and both parse to the exact disposition and SPDDirOut/SPDDirBoth; its claim names disposition and direction only, which is what it asserts. The added negative TestRFC4301SPDRefusesADispositionItDoesNotCarry refuses an absent action, protect, an unknown action and an unknown direction by exact message. Revert records on ipsec/spd_policy.go::parseSPDPolicy for both.
